title: A1 Intensive Course – August 2026 Applications Now Open!
excerpt: Applications are now open for our upcoming A1 Intensive German course starting August 2026. Apply now to secure your spot.
content: We are thrilled to announce that applications for our A1 Intensive German Language Course (August 2026 Batch) are now officially open. This is a 10-week intensive program designed for absolute beginners. Classes are held live online via Google Meet. The course fee is BDT 12,000. Admission is application-based, so don't miss this opportunity — apply now to start your German learning journey with GLAB's expert instructor.
